assessment.decisionReason: PrismDB now has an authenticated tenant-scoped read/write API and remote-durable admission recovery, but the supported shard-node distribution, encryption, backup/hydration and RPO/RTO, independent operational evidence, and organizational deployment gates remain open.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
CSA Cloud Controls Matrix and CAIQ
NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
CSA AI Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire

controls.title: Technical security verification
gaps: No commissioned independent penetration test exists.
The authenticated read listener has in-repository abuse and isolation gates but has not undergone independent ASVS-scoped verification.

controls.title: Release integrity, SBOM, signing, and provenance
gaps: Signed SBOM/provenance release assurance covers the model service and public API coordinator, not the still-absent shard-node database distribution.

controls.title: Identity, authorization, and tenant isolation
gaps: Read and ingest use exact-certificate tenant grants, but independent tenant-escape verification and lifecycle evidence remain open.

controls.title: Transport, storage encryption, and key management
gaps: Per-tenant envelope encryption and production KMS/HSM lifecycle are not implemented.

controls.title: Data protection, privacy, retention, and deletion
gaps: Versioned redact-before-embedding, production retention/deletion, residency, and raw-disk metadata confidentiality remain open.

controls.title: Backup, recovery, failover, and resilience
gaps: No supported backup/restore product workflow or customer-scale RPO/RTO drill exists.

Remote-durable admission, authenticated write transport, and replacement-node recovery are gated, but already-published part hydration and independent-host latency/jitter/scaling evidence remain open.

controls.title: Operational observability and SLO evidence
gaps: The read service exports fixed-cardinality metrics and minimum alert guidance, but no approved SLO/error budget or representative long-running API workload evidence exists.
Distributed tracing and a retained production dashboard/alert validation remain open.

controls.title: Incident and vulnerability response
gaps: Named on-call staff, customer notification, and an exercised incident drill are organizational gates.

controls.title: Model identity, quality, drift, and AI governance
gaps: Real-embedding corpus retuning, production GPU execution evidence, calibrated OOD/drift gates, and long-running service evaluation remain open.

externalGates.title: Production service and supported distribution
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: The shipped authenticated public read/write API is joined by migration/version policy, a complete signed shard-node database distribution, and production deployment manifests that pass release gates.

externalGates.title: Independent penetration test
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Signed final report covers API, shard transport, model plane, tenant isolation, formats, and deployment; critical/high findings are closed or CISO-accepted.

externalGates.title: Production-topology recovery and failover exercise
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Signed customer-scale drill proves approved RPO/RTO, backup restoration, partition behavior, and write failover.

externalGates.title: Support, incident, SLO, and escalation readiness
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Named 24x7 escalation rota, contracted support/SLO targets, status communications, and exercised incident notification procedure.

externalGates.title: Organizational assurance and contractual package
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Buyer-required SIG/CAIQ, DPA, subprocessor/residency disclosure, and applicable SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence approved.
